title: Quorum agreement
contract: Two different values cannot both commit if each commit requires a majority and the three voters do not equivocate.
scope: Three voter bitmasks for values A and B; disjoint votes admitted under non-equivocation; no leader election or liveness claim.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Each accepted commit has at least two distinct voters.
A and B cannot both commit.

variants.description: Compute majority using explicit pair enumeration.
